name: open-calc
description: An open-source interactive STEM learning platform — intuition first, rigor always

scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-graph.mjs && node scripts/build-concept-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-practice-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-blog-manifest.mjs && node src/scripts/build-lesson-titles.js && node scripts/build-lesson-ids.mjs && vite
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-graph.mjs && node scripts/build-concept-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-practice-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-blog-manifest.mjs && node src/scripts/build-lesson-titles.js && node scripts/build-lesson-ids.mjs && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vite build
scripts.manifests: node scripts/build-concept-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-practice-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-blog-manifest.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 node src/scripts/build-lesson-titles.js && node scripts/build-lesson-ids.mjs && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 vite build && npm run desktop:sync-package && npm run desktop:prepare-build && node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --projectDir desktop/staging
scripts.desktop:build:win: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 node src/scripts/build-lesson-titles.js && node scripts/build-lesson-ids.mjs && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 vite build && npm run desktop:sync-package && npm run desktop:prepare-build && node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --projectDir desktop/staging --win portable
scripts.desktop:build:mac: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 node src/scripts/build-lesson-titles.js && node scripts/build-lesson-ids.mjs && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 vite build && npm run desktop:sync-package && npm run desktop:prepare-build && node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --projectDir desktop/staging --mac dmg
scripts.check-code: npm run check-code:python && npm run check-code:js
